title: GRIM Mean Context
description: Information about a target mean reported in a paragraph of a scientific paper, needed to assess GRIM testability.

n.description: The sample size the TARGET mean was computed over. Only report a number if it is stated in this text or unambiguously inferable from it. Use null if the sample size is not in this text.

n_quote.description: Verbatim quote from the text supporting the value of n, or null.

scale_items.description: The number of items of the scale or measure that were averaged to produce each observation, if stated in this text (e.g., 'we averaged the 10 items' -> 10; a single rating -> 1). Use null if not stated.

items_quote.description: Verbatim quote supporting scale_items, or null.

measure_type.description: What kind of quantity the TARGET mean summarises.

integer_data.description: Whether the individual underlying values are whole numbers (true for Likert responses, counts, age in whole years; false for reaction times, amplitudes, difference scores, proportions of trials).
